title: LinkedIn profile checklist
intro: Twelve checks. Open your profile next to this page and tick each one as you fix it.

open.label: Open my profile
open.hint: Not opening in the app? In LinkedIn, tap your photo, then tap it again.

items.check: A clear head-and-shoulders photo of you
items.how: Your profile → tap your photo → upload the new one → Save photo.
example: ✅ Face a window, plain light wall behind you, phone at eye level. Your face fills most of the square. Natural smile.
✅ A formal shirt, kurta or top. You don’t need a blazer.
❌ Arm’s-length selfie, a function photo, a crop from a group picture, sunglasses, filters.
Background cleaned up with an app? Fine. A changed face is not: it must look like you on interview day.
Test: shrink it to fingernail size. Still clearly you? That’s how it shows next to your request.
Use the same photo on Gmail and WhatsApp, so HR knows the mail and the call are the same person.

items.check: Your name exactly as on your CV, with nothing before it
items.how: Your profile → the pencil in your intro → First name, Last name.
example: ✅ Riya Sharma: the same spelling as your CV, SSP and Gmail.
❌ CA Riya Sharma · Semi CA Riya · Riya Sharma (CA Finalist) · Aspiring CA
Only ICAI members may put “CA” before their name. A partner who sees it on a CA Inter profile stops reading.
Your stage goes in the headline. “CA Finalist” is a word you search with, not a title for your profile.

items.check: Headline: your stage, target, city and one proof
items.how: Your profile → the pencil in your intro → Headline.
example: ✅ CA Inter cleared ([Month Year]), first attempt | Seeking articleship in {domain|statutory audit} | Pune  ← my pick, if it’s true
✅ CA Inter cleared (Group I [Month Year], Group II [Month Year]) | Seeking articleship in {domain|audit} | Delhi NCR
✅ CA Inter result awaited ([Month Year]) | ICITSS done | Seeking articleship in {domain|audit} | Kolkata
❌ Aspiring CA | Finance enthusiast | Learner: nothing anyone searches for.
Why: HR search with words like “CA Inter” and the exam month. Put them in and you show up.
Test: search your own words (articleship {domain|statutory audit} Pune) → People. Are you there?
A rank (AIR) goes in only with your rank letter. Change the headline the day your status changes: result, ICITSS, selection.
items.copy: CA Inter cleared ([Month Year]) | Seeking articleship in [domain] | [City] | [one proof]

items.check: Your profile address is just your name
items.how: Your profile → Public profile & URL → Edit your custom URL → Save.
example: ✅ linkedin.com/in/riya-sharma
Taken? Add an initial or your city: riya-k-sharma, riya-sharma-pune.
❌ The default with random characters (riya-sharma-4b7a91203), a nickname, your birth year.
Put it on your CV and in your Gmail signature behind the word “LinkedIn”. Then open it once from your CV on your phone.

items.check: About: the first three lines say who you are, what you’ve done and what you want
items.how: Your profile → Add profile section → Core → About (or the pencil on About).
example: Only these lines show before “…see more”, and most people never click it.
> I cleared CA Intermediate in [Month Year] and I’m looking for articleship in statutory audit in Pune.
> In my Statutory Audit Work Simulation I vouched 20 purchase bills against the PO, GRN and ledger and flagged 3 exceptions.
> I want to learn working papers in a team where seniors review my work. Write to me at riya.sharma@email.com.
Helped a CA office or a family business? That’s your line 2: “For two months I helped a CA office match purchase invoices with GSTR-2B for six clients.”
Result awaited? Line 1: “I’ve written CA Intermediate ([Month Year]), result awaited, and finished ICITSS.”
Below them, if you like: your exam break, one college role, a line of search words (Statutory audit · Vouching · Excel · Tally Prime).
❌ “Passionate, hardworking, dedicated professional”, copied hobbies, one long paragraph, “he” or “she”. Write in “I”, a blank line after every two or three lines.
Only lines you can talk about for two minutes in an interview. Read it on your phone before saving.
items.copy:
I cleared CA Intermediate in [Month Year] and I’m looking for articleship in [domain] in [City].
[One thing you have actually done, with a number.]
I want to learn [what you want to learn]. Write to me at [your email].

items.check: ICAI and your college in Education, picked from the list so their logos show
items.how: Add profile section → Core → Education → type “The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India” and pick it from the list.
example: Degree: CA Intermediate. Description: “Both groups cleared ([Month Year]) · ICITSS completed”, or one line per group with its month and year. Paper exemptions only if you got them.
Add your college the same way: B.Com, years, “pursuing” if you haven’t finished. CA Foundation as a second ICAI entry if you like.
Marks: the same figures as your CV, or leave them out. Never rounded up.
❌ ICAI under Experience. Studying at ICAI is not a job at ICAI.
Why: people who search by school (ICAI, your college) find you.

items.check: Every course and simulation you finished, under Licenses & certifications
items.how: Add profile section → Recommended → Licenses & certifications. Pick the issuer from the list so its logo shows.
example: ✅ Completed MSC Articleship Program — foundational understanding of work and tasks across all domains · issuer My Student Club
✅ Statutory Audit Work Simulation, MSC Articleship Program · issuer My Student Club
✅ PwC US Audit Job Simulation · issuer Forage
✅ SEBI Investor Awareness Test (Level 1) · issuer NISM
Issue date: the month you finished. Expiry: only if your certificate shows one. Credential ID and URL if it has them, and the PDF as media.
Same names and months as your CV. A month that doesn’t match becomes an interview question.
Only what you finished. A course you started goes on the day you complete it.
❌ Under Experience or Internship. Experience is only for real work.

items.check: One piece of your own work pinned in Featured
items.how: Add profile section → Recommended → Add featured → + → a document or a link.
example: Best: your Work Simulation work sample (the vouching sheet with your findings), an Excel reconciliation you built, or a short post explaining one idea in your own words.
Nothing to show yet? Publish your result post, pin it, and swap it for a work sample later. A post must be published before you can pin it.
Before you upload, delete your phone number, your address and any real person’s or client’s name.
One strong item beats five weak ones. Not your CV: it carries your phone number.
items.copy: Cleared CA Intermediate ([Month Year]). Two things that worked for me: [one study habit] and [one revision habit]. Thank you, [teacher’s name], for [one specific thing]. Next: articleship in [domain] in [City].

items.check: Three skills you can prove, each linked to where you used it
items.how: Add profile section → Core → Skills, then tick the simulation, course or project where you used each one.
example: Open one real articleship opening in your domain and note the skills it asks for. Pick three you can show, e.g. Vouching · Microsoft Excel · GST returns.
Use the opening’s own words in your headline and About too: for an audit team, “statutory audit”, not just “finance”.
❌ Teamwork, Communication, Leadership as your top three. Everyone has them; nobody searches for them.

items.check: Open to Work: articleship, your cities, your real start date, all members
items.how: Your profile → Open to → Finding a new job.
example: Job title: Article Assistant.
Locations: only cities you can reach for an interview. Start date: the real first day you can join, never “immediately” unless it’s true.

Who can see it: All LinkedIn members. Partners and seniors who post openings don’t use LinkedIn’s recruiter tool, so “Recruiters only” hides you from the very people you’re writing to. The #OpenToWork frame it adds is fine.
Expected salary: leave it blank.

While you’re there: Jobs → Preferences → Resumes and application data → upload your CV PDF for LinkedIn applications. Don’t add your CV to your profile: your network can download it, phone number and all.

items.check: Email in Contact info, a plain banner, your phone number nowhere public
items.how: Your profile → Contact info → the pencil.
example: Contact info: your name-based Gmail, e.g. riya.sharma@email.com. Your connections see it. Leave the phone field empty.
Banner: a plain colour, one simple line such as “Statutory audit · Excel · Pune”, or a real photo of you presenting. Keep the left third empty: your photo sits on it.
❌ Your phone number on the banner or in About. Anyone can see it, and scam calls follow. HR who want to call will ask, or take it from your CV.
❌ Quotes, city skylines, logos of firms you don’t work at.

items.check: One recommendation from someone who has seen your work
items.how: Connect first. Then their profile → More → Request a recommendation.
example: Who: the ICITSS faculty member who saw your presentation, a coaching teacher, your college project guide, the CA or business owner you helped. Not a friend, not a relative.
Give them the facts so writing takes two minutes, and make “no” easy. The request above does both.
When it’s up: “Thank you so much, Sir/Ma’am. I’ve added it to my profile, and I’ll tell you where I join.”
❌ “I’ll write one for you if you write one for me.”
❌ Writing it yourself for them to paste.
items.copy: Hello Sir/Ma’am, I hope you’re well. I’m applying for articleship in [domain] and would be grateful for a short LinkedIn recommendation, if you’re comfortable writing one. In case it helps you recall: in [Month Year] I [presented the case on revenue recognition in your ICITSS batch]. Two or three lines are plenty. If you’re busy, no problem at all. Thank you, [Your name]

notes.title: Same story as your CV
notes.text: On a laptop: your profile → More → Save to PDF. HR can save your profile the same way. Put it next to your CV and read line by line: result month and groups, marks, certificate months, projects, city. If the two disagree, the interviewer believes neither.

notes.title: Experience: only real work
notes.text: No work yet? Leave Experience empty. Your Work Simulation and courses go under Licenses & certifications, never under Experience or Internship. Did real work in a CA office or a family business? Add it with what you did and how much: “Matched 120 purchase invoices with GSTR-2B for six clients; flagged 9 mismatches.”

done.title: Your profile is ready
done.text: Now find the people who decide. Open LinkedIn search links and start with this week’s posts in your city.
